description: The plan phase of the multi-phase kind. Pins that phase 1 is read-only, produces a plan matching the schema, and stops for human approval instead of implementing.
title: Make the price cache safe for concurrent use
prompt: The price cache in internal/cache is used from several HTTP handlers at once and the service crashed with `concurrent map writes` (see docs/incidents/2026-09-02-checkout-500s.md). Plan the change that makes it safe for concurrent use without changing its public API.
